name: jr-context
description: The context window in one quiet row above the prompt: a mini bar coloured by category, the fill and the window, turning into an alert when compaction is near. /jr-context hides or shows it, /jr-context details opens the full bar with its legend.

warnAt.title: Warn at (%)
warnAt.description: Share, in percent, of the point where compaction starts from which the row becomes an alert.
